policy: latest direct user restores original capture methods and Rust-first product core; no C5 substitution for C1

mysql.position: GTID/source lineage, ROW/FULL, transaction boundaries, L0/Lend/applied/ACK
mysql.snapshot: initial CDC-first snapshot or explicit batch capability only; C5 not C1 exit

mariadb.snapshot: C5 is separate batch/reconcile proof, not original C1 completion

postgresql.position: LSN, publication/slot DBA, transactional apply/applied/slot ACK
postgresql.snapshot: CDC-first snapshot initial only, preserve existing live slot

mongodb.required: C1 change stream on replica-set/sharded target
mongodb.position: resume token opaque; clusterTime not conflated, txn proof before gradeT, POSITION_EXPIRED
mongodb.snapshot: standalone C5 is allowed standalone capability only; self-provision replica-set fixture for primary C1 route

sqlserver.required: documented C1 native CDC or C2 Change Tracking
sqlserver.position: real LSN/CT version and retention/snapshot semantics, no fake T on CT
sqlserver.snapshot: current real C2 allowed; C5 cannot replace declared CT/CDC

oracle.required: verified batch C3/C5, S1 if same SCN proven
oracle.position: real SCN/snapshot guarantee only, C3 delete reconcile caveat
oracle.snapshot: allowed batch; LogMiner C1 off without separate ADR/R1w/permissions

clickhouse.required: applicable C4 parts/partition refresh or documented C3/C5
clickhouse.position: FINAL/delete async/partition epoch/CAS/ACK and actual grade
clickhouse.snapshot: C5 allowed where applicable; no logCDC claim

doris.required: applicable C4 partition refresh or documented C3/C5
doris.position: partition epoch/tablemodel; no external CDC for supported2.x/3.x
doris.snapshot: allowed method per table, not C1

starrocks.required: applicable C4 partition refresh or documented C3/C5

opensearch.required: C5 reconcile or C3 with explicit delete reconciliation
opensearch.position: PIT/search_after, mapping schema, B actual consistency

hash_scope: fixed original contract text at this source commit, prior to the coordinator event append; not a live worktree checksum
